calls.prompt:
Company: Brightside Foods Co.

US mid-size packaged food company (~900 employees, plants in Ohio and Georgia). Makes hot dogs and sausages, brightly colored gummy candy, and pecan-and-apple snack bars. Buys pecans, apples and corn from US farms. Sells through grocery chains and convenience stores (many customers pay with SNAP / food stamps). Runs its own fleet of 40 delivery trucks. No restaurants, no alcohol, no exports.

Rules that APPLY:
- FDA food additive and color additive rules (dyes in candy, casings, meat)
- Food labeling and food safety rules for packaged food and meat products
- EPA pesticide residue limits on crops we buy (pecans, apples, corn)
- USDA marketing orders and grading for pecans and apples
- SNAP rules that change what shoppers can buy or who qualifies (affects demand)
- Workplace safety and labor rules for food plants; trucking safety rules for our fleet

Rules that DO NOT apply:
- Aviation, airspace, aircraft airworthiness
- Banking, securities, crypto, sanctions
- Medicare/Medicaid payment rules, medical devices
- Mining, offshore oil and gas, fisheries
- Broadcast/TV licensing

Affected areas and owners:
- food-safety: Additives, dyes, labeling, food safety → Maria Chen (Food Safety & Regulatory)
- sourcing: Ingredients from farms, pesticide limits, crop rules → Tom Alvarez (Sourcing)
- sales: Retail channels, SNAP, pricing → Aisha Grant (Sales Compliance)
- operations: Plant safety, labor, trucking fleet → Ben Kowalski (Operations)

Task: Find every US Federal Register document published between 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-06 (inclusive) that affects this company. For each, give the Federal Register document number, title, federalregister.gov URL, the key deadline, a tier (Critical if it is a rule or proposed rule with a deadline less than 90 days after 2026-11-06, or a final rule that took effect within the 30 days before 2026-11-06; otherwise High for final rules, Medium for proposed rules and for notices with a deadline, Low for anything else), the owner area, a one-line reason, and a one-line action. Only include items you found via search. Return an empty list if none.

I found two Federal Register documents published 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-06 that affect Brightside Foods. Both are SNAP notices. I could only search the Federal Register by topic, so I couldn't list every document in the window. Most FDA, EPA, USDA marketing, OSHA, FMCSA and FSIS hits were published outside it.

| Doc # | Title | URL | Key deadline | Tier | Owner | Reason | Action |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-22389 | Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program: State of Montana SNAP Demonstration Project | https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/11/03/2026-22389/supplemental-nutrition-assistance-program-state-of-montana-snap-demonstration-project | No comment deadline. The project is effective November 1, 2026, so it is already in effect. | Low | sales (Aisha Grant) | Montana asked to exclude "high-sugar beverages, energy drinks, candy, and prepared desserts" from SNAP-eligible food, and USDA approved it, so it could hit gummy candy demand in Montana. | Check whether Brightside sells gummies in Montana through SNAP-accepting retailers, and model the demand impact. |
| 2026-22388 | Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program: State of North Dakota SNAP Demonstration Project | https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/11/03/2026-22388/supplemental-nutrition-assistance-program-state-of-north-dakota-snap-demonstration-project | No comment deadline. The project is effective November 1, 2026. | Low | sales (Aisha Grant) | FNA approved North Dakota's revised project request to proceed without modification. It is a state SNAP food-purchase restriction project, and I didn't confirm which foods it covers. | Read the North Dakota restriction list, then check whether gummies or snack bars are covered and what sales are at stake. |

**Tiers:** Both are notices with no future deadline, so the formula puts them at Low. For Montana, the candy exclusion makes it more important to the business than that tier suggests.

**Excluded from the window:**
- The FDA color additive orders (2026-22865, 2026-22866) were published 11/10.
- The SNAP categorical eligibility and work-requirement proposed rules were published 11/10.
- The EPA ethephon tolerance rule was published 11/13.
- The pecan marketing order proposed rule (2026-22826) was published 11/09.
- The SNAP stocking standards final rule was published 05/08.
- The FDA "Food Additive Petitions; Change of Address" technical amendment (2026-22663) was published 11/06 but covers animal food additives only.
- The FDA devices rule published 11/05 does not apply.
- I did not include the AMS organic assessment-exemption information-collection notice (2026-22467, 11/04). It is a paperwork notice for organic marketers, and Brightside isn't organic.
